# Containment of SCP-096
By default, SCP-096 appears in its containment chamber, which restricts its movement and prevents it from leaving. The containment chamber serves as a deterrent, making containment safe.
[textlink="General Information about Shy Guy" link="Scp096About"]
[textlink="More about escape methods as Shy Guy" link="Scp096ContainmentBreach"]
## What should you do?
The object's primary method of breaching containment is by using its "Face Rip" ability. This allows it to damage the face, causing injury.
[textlink="More on Abilities" link="Scp096Abilities"]
Please note that this ability can only be used 15 minutes after the start of the round, as the "Safe Time" mechanic is active during this period; this limits the activity of SCP objects and grants personnel time to complete their initial preparations for the round.
Tearing the skin from its face 5 times will allow the "Shy Guy" to pulverize its face into bloody pulp, transitioning it into the "Flayed Face" state. In this state, it is able to exit its containment chamber and attack personnel.
[textlink="More on States" link="Scp096States"]
The personnel's objective is to prevent the Shy Guy from pulverizing its face, and generally preventing escape. To achieve this, they must periodically restore the object's face using medical plasters.
## How to Determine the Severity of Facial Damage?
It is crucial for personnel to perform facial restoration procedures on the "Shy Guy" in a timely manner; therefore, an accurate assessment of his condition is a key factor in this process.
Qualified personnel — specifically scientific staff and certain medical personnel — can immediately assess the severity of the subject's injuries. This severity level is indicated by a visible icon displayed in the top-right corner above the subject.
The more blood visible on the icon's face, the greater the extent of the facial damage.
An alternative method for obtaining this information is to inspect Shy Guy using Shift + Click. The resulting menu will provide a textual description of the subject's condition, which can assist in assessing the situation.
Qualified personnel — specifically scientific staff — are capable of assessing the criticality of such damage and providing an immediate evaluation. Information regarding the urgency of restoring the containment unit will be provided below, provided the staff member possesses the requisite qualifications.
## Containment Chamber Repairs
Shy Guy possesses the ability to generate a powerful anomalous resonance, inflicting colossal structural damage to its immediate surroundings via a sonic wave. Fortunately, the Object's containment chamber is designed based on the principles of an "anechoic chamber," thereby partially suppressing this destructive capability.
However, the containment chamber is not indestructible! Constant exposure to high-intensity sound waves causes deformation and structural damage to the chamber walls.
To prevent a containment breach, repair work must be performed every 20–25 minutes, requiring the deployment of qualified technical personnel equipped with the necessary materials and tools.
## What to Do If the Subject Escapes?
The Foundation's arsenal includes high-tech containment devices in the form of a "Head Bag" and a "Mask," which can be applied to a subject. While the subject is wearing these devices, they are unable to attack or resist transport.
The subject may tear through the containment gear after a certain period of time has elapsed since its application. The higher the quality of the gear, the more difficult it is to breach.
If the subject has destroyed their face, a prudent course of action is to employ non-lethal weaponry to subdue the subject prior to applying the containment gear. Note that significant force will be required to subdue the subject; a single officer armed with a taser will not suffice!
## Photographs
Sometimes, chance can be the decisive factor. The game features a random event that generates copies of the SCP-096 photograph throughout the facility and within players' inventories.
Anyone who views the photograph by inspecting it becomes a target of Shy Guy, thereby triggering a change in its state.
However, these photographs can also work to the staff's advantage. For instance, if a target of The Shy Guy is successfully confined within its containment chamber — and the chamber is sealed in time — the Special Containment Procedures can be re-established with minimal casualties.
A photograph can also be generated manually by using a laboratory camera on Shy Guy.
